children: Sales of branded goods outpaced own-labels in the U.K. grocery market in August, reversing a defining trend from earlier in the year, Barclays analysts say in a note. For the four weeks to Sept. 6, sales of branded goods grew 3.7% while own label sales grew 2.9%, according to data from Worldpanel by Numerator released Tuesday. However, shoppers still have a strong appetite for promotions, the data provider said. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
